name: Audio and Music Engineering
notes: 130 total credits: 32 basic science and mathematics, 60 engineering, 6 writing, 20 humanities and social sciences (cluster), 12 free electives.

NEEDS VERIFICATION - the five subject areas: the page lists courses across Recording Arts and Sound Design, Acoustics, Audio Electronics, Signal Processing, and Software Design, marking the OPTIONAL ones in italics. The saved HTML preserves no italic markup, so required and elective courses in those lists cannot be told apart. They are modeled here as one course from each of the five areas, which matches the page's statement that the degree 'requires completion of courses and portfolio projects in five subject areas'. Confirm the exact required course in each area against the AME Curriculum Guide PDF.

Basic music competency is a minimum of 10 credits: 8 credits of music theory (MUSC 101 and MUSC 111 minimum; students with proficiency may start at MUSC 110 followed by MUSC 111) and 2 credits of musicianship (two 1-credit courses from MUSC 109, 113, 114, 115, or one 2-credit course MUSC 201 or MUSC 202). Placement is by exam.
Courses taken for the music competency requirement may also count toward a music cluster and toward the H&SS requirement.
MATH 141, 142, 143 may be substituted for MATH 161 and 162.
The H&SS requirement is five courses including the three-course cluster and the music competency courses.

requirementGroups.label: AME foundations
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Foundations Courses (Completed by all students): AME 140: Intro to Audio and Music Engineering; AME 141: Fundamentals for Digital Design

requirementGroups.label: Calculus sequence
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Calculus sequence option A: MATH 161; MATH 162; MATH 164; MATH 165 or MATH 163. Calculus sequence option B: MATH 171; MATH 172; MATH 173; MATH 174. MATH 141, 142, 143 may be substituted for MATH 161 and 162.

requirementGroups.label: Probability and statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Natural Science: ECE 270; STATS 180 or 190; PHYSICS (2 courses)

requirementGroups.label: Physics (2 courses)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHYSICS (2 courses) PHYS 121, PHYS 122; PHYS 113, 114 or PHYS 141, PHYS 142

requirementGroups.label: Music theory
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The minimum requirement is completion of MUSC 101 and MUSC 111, however students with appropriate background and demonstrated proficiency in music theory may begin in a higher-level course such as MUSC 110 followed by MUSC 111.

requirementGroups.label: Musicianship
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: To meet the musicianship requirement, students normally would complete two one-credit courses: MUSC 109, MUSC 113, MUSC 114, MUSC 115 or one two credit course: MUSC 201 or MUSC 202.
requirementGroups.note: Two 1-credit courses or one 2-credit course; modeled as a single selection.

requirementGroups.label: Recording arts and sound design
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: 1. Recording Arts and Sound Design: AME 191: Art and Technology of Recording; AME 193: Sound Design; AME 240; AME 242; AME 244; AME 391; AME 393

requirementGroups.label: Acoustics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: 2. Acoustics: AME 233/PHYS 233: Musical Acoustics; AME 292: Acoustics Portfolio (2 credits); ECE 439: Electroacoustics and Spatial Audio

requirementGroups.label: Audio electronics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: 3. Audio Electronics: AME 140; ECE 113: Circuits and Signals; AME 223: Audio Electronics; AME 295: Audio Electronics Portfolio (2 credits); ECE 216; ECE 222; ECE 261/461: Introduction to VLSI

requirementGroups.label: Signal processing
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: 4. Signal Processing: ECE 241: Signals; AME 272: Audio Signal Processing; AME 294: Audio DSP Portfolio (2); AME 277/477: Computer Audition; ECE 246/446: Digital Signal Processing

requirementGroups.label: Software design
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: 5. Software Design: ECE 114: Introduction to Computers and Programming; AME 262: Audio Software Design; AME 264: Audio Software Design II; AME 196: Interactive Music Programming; CSC 172: Data Structures & Algorithms; CSC 210: Web Programming

requirementGroups.label: Senior design project
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All AME majors must complete a one-year senior design project: AME 386/387: Senior Design Project I and II.

requirementGroups.label: Humanities/social science beyond the cluster
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All AME majors must take a minimum of 5 humanities and/or social science (H&SS) courses. This includes the three courses taken to satisfy the University Cluster requirement, and the AME music competency requirement.
requirementGroups.note: Five total: three from the cluster, plus the music competency courses, leaving roughly one further course.
